seo.description: Fullstack web developer specializing in JavaScript, Java, Angular, and React. Discover my projects and my world.

about.title: Behind
about.note1: Hello, I'm Clara 👋 I'm a fullstack developer and what I love is turning ideas into concrete, useful and well thought out projects. I enjoy working on both the technical and user experience aspects, because for me, a good project is a mix of efficiency and simplicity!
about.note2: Off-screen, I'm a huge plant lover! And recently, a little puppy has joined my daily life, which teaches me patience and creativity in a way other than coding!
about.note3: If you'd like to know more about my background, you can take a look at my Resume. And if you have a web project in mind or simply want to chat, I would be happy to discuss it with you. You can contact me directly using the form below 👇

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy

content.subtitle: Data Controller
content.description: This portfolio website is published by Clara SLYS, acting as the data controller within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR – EU Regulation 2016/679). For any questions regarding the protection of your data, you can contact me at the following email address: slys.clara1@gmail.com

content.subtitle: Data Collected
content.description:
As part of the use of the contact form on this website, the following data is collected:
  - Full name
  - Company name
  - Email address
  - Subject of the message
  - Message content
No other personal data is collected through this website.

content.subtitle: Purpose and Legal Basis for Processing
content.description:
The data collected via the contact form is used exclusively to respond to your requests and messages.
The legal basis for this processing is the legitimate interest of the data controller (Article 6.1.f of the GDPR), namely the handling of contact requests in the context of their professional activity.

content.subtitle: Retention Period
content.description: Data submitted via the contact form is retained only for the time necessary to process your request, and deleted no later than 12 months after the last interaction.

content.subtitle: Data Recipients
content.description:
Your data is not sold, rented, or transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.
It is, however, transmitted to the following technical service providers, strictly within the scope of their services:
  - EmailJS: The contact form uses the EmailJS service (EmailJS.com) to forward messages to the data controller's email inbox.
  - EmailJS Privacy Policy: [https://www.emailjs.com/legal/privacy-policy/](https://www.emailjs.com/legal/privacy-policy/). EmailJS acts as a data processor and handles your data in accordance with its own privacy policy.
  - Google reCAPTCHA v3: This website uses Google reCAPTCHA v3 (Google LLC) to protect the contact form against automated submissions (spam and bots). reCAPTCHA v3 collects information about user interactions with the website (mouse movements, browsing duration, browser data, IP address) for behavioral analysis purposes, without presenting any visible challenge to the user. This data is processed by Google LLC, headquartered in the United States. This transfer is governed by the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.
  - Google Privacy Policy: [https://policies.google.com/privacy](https://policies.google.com/privacy)
  - reCAPTCHA Terms of Service: [https://policies.google.com/terms](https://policies.google.com/terms)

content.subtitle: Cookies
content.description:
This website does not use any tracking or analytics cookies.
The only mechanism that may store data in your browser is Google reCAPTCHA v3, as part of its operation described in section 5.

content.subtitle: Your Rights
content.description:
In accordance with the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
  - Right of access: obtain a copy of the data concerning you
  - Right of rectification: correct inaccurate or incomplete data
  - Right to erasure: request the deletion of your data
  - Right to restriction of processing: limit the use of your data
  - Right to object: object to the processing of your data
  - Right to data portability: receive your data in a structured format
To exercise these rights, you may send your request to: slys.clara1@gmail.com
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority. In France, this is the Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés (CNIL): [https://www.cnil.fr](https://www.cnil.fr)

content.subtitle: Data Security
content.description: Appropriate technical and organizational measures are implemented to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, or disclosure.

content.subtitle: Changes to This Policy
content.description: This privacy policy may be updated from time to time. The date of the last update is indicated at the top of the document. We encourage you to consult it regularly.

privacy-policy.conformity: This document was drafted in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of April 27, 2016 on the protection of personal data (GDPR).
